race.description: Ladbrokes Racing Extras In Multi Max 150 Points
race.comment: MISDIRECTION (1) missed the frame latest when seventh at this track (18.07) but scored three back at Gosford (22.62). Better than the latest effort and deserves another chance. SUPER SKUNK (8) trailed the lead and fought on well to be beaten 2.25 lengths into third (17.72) at this track in a Grade 5 over 300m. Will give a great sight again. REDEEM A ARCADIA (6) flew the lids and led throughout to score last time at big odds, winning by a nose at this track over 300m (17.64). Bold showing expected again. LUNAR MOON (2) must be respected despite an unplaced effort here most recently.

runners.name: Peta Zoom
